rationale: This is a standard Hyperledger Fabric chaincode with Init and Invoke entrypoints. The code uses only deterministic operations: GetState, PutState, DelState with values derived from transaction arguments. There are no time.Now() calls (C1), no goroutines (C2), no map iterations (C3), no rich queries like GetQueryResult (C4), and no package-level mutable state (C6). All state operations are based on deterministic input from transaction arguments.
